test_case: Phantom Brew whitebox flows › cart coupon applies a visible discount to the order total
estimated_root_cause: Add to Cart on /menu/1 did not update cart state; badge stayed 0 before coupon flow began.
recommended_action: Investigate add-to-cart handler/state sync on product detail page and verify cart badge increments after click.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › ステータスが「preparing」に進む
estimated_root_cause: Order status transition is timing-dependent and may remain received past the test's check window due to random delay.
recommended_action: Poll/wait for status progression with a longer bounded timeout instead of asserting immediately.

test_case: 注文ステータスページ › 最終的にステータスが「completed」になる
estimated_root_cause: Async status progression never advanced from received within 15s, consistent with delayed or nondeterministic updates.
recommended_action: Stabilize backend/UI status simulation or make the test wait on deterministic progression events with a larger timeout.

test_case: レート制限テスト › 通常のページ遷移でエラーが出ない
estimated_root_cause: Selector 'h1, .product-card' matches many elements, causing Playwright strict mode failure.
recommended_action: Use a single unambiguous locator or assert count/any-visible explicitly instead of a multi-match locator.
